Read HaploBreedR Pipeline Results from Disk

Source: R/hgsi-io.r
hbr_read_results.Rd

Ingests completed single-trait or multi-trait pipeline output directories into memory as classed objects for visualization or genomic selection.

Usage

hbr_read_results(path = NULL, traits = NULL)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to a single trait output directory.

traits

Optional named character vector of output directories for multi-trait loading.

Value

An object of class hbr_run (single trait) or hbr_run_list (multi-trait).

Examples

toy <- system.file("extdata", "test_data", package = "HaploBreedR")
if (nzchar(toy) && dir.exists(toy)) {
  res <- try(hbr_read_results(path = toy))
}
